name: 7 Cups
one_liner: Free anonymous text chats with trained volunteer listeners and peer forums, plus paid text therapy with licensed therapists.
best_for: People who want someone to talk to anonymously, for free, at any hour
People not ready for therapy who want peer support first
People who want low-cost text-based therapy and don't need insurance
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988 (listeners are volunteers, not crisis counselors)
People who want to use insurance (7 Cups therapy isn't covered)
People who need medication or a diagnosis
People who want strong privacy: the policy allows sharing with advertising partners
short_description: Free anonymous chat with trained volunteer listeners and community forums; licensed text therapy is a paid add-on.
long_description: 7 Cups (7 Cups of Tea) is a peer support service. Anyone can chat anonymously, for free, with a volunteer listener who has done 7 Cups' online active-listening training, join group chats and forums, or work through self-help guides. Listeners are not therapists or crisis counselors. A paid option adds text-based therapy with a licensed therapist; 7 Cups' help center says it costs under $50 a week (several reviews report about $150 a month), and insurance does not cover it. The privacy policy says it may share personal data with marketing and advertising partners for targeted ads where the law allows. Research on 7 Cups itself is limited to small uncontrolled studies.

pricing.notes: Peer chat, forums and many guides are free. 7 Cups' help center (Jan 2024) says therapy costs under $50 a week; several reviews report $150/month. Not covered by insurance.

privacy.notes: Policy says it may share personal data with marketing and advertising partners for targeted ads where permitted; account data can be purged on request (privacy@7cups.com).

seo.meta_description: 7 Cups provides free peer support through trained listeners plus optional online therapy, connecting millions seeking emotional support worldwide.

faqs.a: Yes, peer support with trained listeners is completely free. You can chat anonymously with volunteers who provide emotional support. Paid online therapy with licensed therapists is also available for those wanting professional treatment, but the core peer support is free.

Listeners are volunteers who complete 7 Cups' active listening training. They're not therapists but are trained to provide empathetic, non-judgmental support. Anyone can become a listener. Quality varies, but the training emphasizes supportive listening skills.
Yes, you can use 7 Cups anonymously. Conversations with listeners are private. Like all platforms, there are limits around imminent harm. Review their privacy policy for details on data handling.

faqs.q: Should I use 7 Cups or see a therapist?
faqs.a: 7 Cups peer support is great for everyday stress and needing someone to talk to. For mental health conditions like depression or anxiety, professional therapy is more appropriate. 7 Cups also offers paid therapy for those ready for professional treatment.

patient_summary: On 7 Cups you can chat anonymously with a trained volunteer listener for free, any time, or join peer forums. If you want a licensed therapist, there's a paid text-therapy plan that insurance doesn't cover. Listeners are not crisis counselors, so call or text 988 in an emergency.
